notes.title: RED LIGHTNING OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

The wait is over—Red Lightning is now available on Steam! 🎉

This game has been a massive learning experience for me, and after years of development, I’m excited to finally share the full version with you. If you enjoy fast-paced action, unique challenges, and a game made with heart, I hope you’ll check it out.

🔹 What to expect in Red Lightning:
✅ Intense combat and challenging levels
✅ A full-speed adventure with no microtransactions
✅ A built-in speedrun timer for those who want to test their skills
✅ A game made with passion, designed to be played and enjoyed in its purest form

If you’ve been following the project, now’s the time to jump in! Let me know what you think, and if you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a review—it really helps get the word out.

Thank you for your support, and I hope you have a blast playing Red Lightning! 🚀⚡
